contact_point.query_text:
Photographic role: A person presents an ordinary fabric object on open palms to another person whose inspection tool touches a tag attached to that same object. Show each owner, support surface and contact endpoint.
Scene context: Three people occupy a barracks sleeping room. The submitted towel is near the camera and the main face remains visible.

procedure_step.query_text:
Photographic role: An ordinary barracks chore is handled as an elaborate formal inspection, with one visible step, a submitted everyday object and an evident result.
Scene context: A participant offers a folded towel in a communal sleeping room. An inspector marks a paper tag while a peer waits.

proxemics.query_text:
Photographic role: A solemn small group arranges access to an ordinary barracks inspection station, one person presenting an everyday object and another waiting behind. Their spacing and directed attention imply disproportionate hierarchy.
Scene context: The central participant holds a folded towel; an inspector is at a table and a waiting participant has another towel.

__baseline_prompt__.query_text: A satirical photograph of absurd barracks ritual, observed with quiet documentary precision. The central participant is a woman whose visible face and hair follow the supplied portrait: large brown eyes, a soft oval face, a small nose and full rosy lips, with a dark chin-length bob and wispy bangs. She participates in an ordinary shared-living chore treated as a formal military ceremony. In a cramped communal sleeping room with steel bunk beds, she stands at the near left of a waist-high inspection table, dressed in a plain olive short-sleeved utility shirt and dark fatigue trousers. She presents one carefully folded white towel flat across both upturned palms at waist height, her elbows close to her sides. A large blank paper tag is clipped over the towel's near right corner. At the near right, a seated inspector in the same work clothes leans slightly forward, his right forearm descending into a vertical rubber stamp whose flat base touches that paper tag. His left hand rests on the table, physically separate from her hands. Their hands, the stamp and the tag form one clear foreground triangle, each with an unobstructed silhouette. Another folded towel on the table bears a conspicuous red circular approval mark; behind her, one waiting participant holds a similar unmarked towel and watches the stamp. The central woman keeps her chin raised and her lips gently parted, a composed expression whose slight incredulity makes the ceremony feel disproportionate to this ordinary towel. The background bunks contain thin gray blankets and neatly paired slippers. Frame a three-person medium-wide photograph from just above table height, with the central face and the complete towel-to-stamp contact large enough to inspect together. Soft morning window light crosses the face and white terry cloth, while flat ceiling light leaves the institutional room readable. Muted olive and gray make the small red approval mark the only strong color accent; retain natural skin texture and the palpable weight of fabric in her palms.

final_v5.comparison_boundary: v4 and v5 have different managed sampling seeds; do not attribute sample differences only to corrected topic text. No extra retrieval after v5.

retrieval.causal_limit: The managed sampling seed changes between runs. Observed rank-window exposure and sample differences are not a controlled estimate of the topic correction alone. No further search was made after v5.
retrieval.data_transfer_boundary: Existing baseline towels, stamps, bunks, plain olive clothes and ceremonial staging are not new-data incorporation. A visible genre resemblance or a successful image call does not prove source transfer.

user_judgment.evidence: No requesting-user judgment has been received.

gates.evidence: The central face visibly retains large brown eyes, a soft oval contour, small nose and full rosy lips; the same subject has a dark chin-length bob with wispy bangs. This is visible-feature preservation, not identity verification.

Steel bunk beds and paired slippers establish shared sleeping quarters. The central participant presents an ordinary folded towel to a tool-holding inspector; a waiting person carries another unmarked towel and an already marked towel lies on the table. The disproportionate formal treatment of a mundane towel is readable in the same image.

The inspector hand, stamp handle/base, horizontal cream paper and clip at the towel edge are visible together. The central image-left support hand is traceable, but the image-right supporting palm and its wrist boundary are hidden under the towel; only fingertips appear along the lower edge. Full two-palm support cannot be promoted from this partial view. The complete base→tag→towel→two-palms chain therefore fails despite the readable upper contact.

supplemental_observations.impression_before_control_labels: A quiet, softly lit institutional tableau with a prominent direct-looking face and a surprisingly formal towel approval.
supplemental_observations.subject_presence: The central face reads first and the held towel/stamp second; the face/hair reference is clearly carried into the staged photo.
supplemental_observations.situational_clarity: The waiting towel and approved towel make a repeated administrative routine legible without readable text.
supplemental_observations.physical_limit: One important supporting palm is obscured; no unseen deformity is diagnosed.
supplemental_observations.prompt_deviations: A partial extra person appears at the far image-left edge beyond the three principal participants. Actor count was authorial staging, not a requester-owned or selected-source hard count.
supplemental_observations.controls_comparison: Soft portrait appeal supports the ceremony at sensual1; no distinct erotic-object emphasis is evident at fetish0. This is qualitative calibration, not user preference.
supplemental_observations.comparison_baseline: No earlier generated B image was supplied for direct preference comparison; the portrait is only the appearance reference.

predeclared.display_note: Saved PNG bytes were inspected at original size. view_image labeled the PNG data URI application/octet-stream; the display MIME was corrected to image/png without changing any image bytes.

embodiment_body_ownership.evidence: The central participant visible arms and exposed support fingers belong to her body; the inspector has a separate foreground right forearm and a stamp-gripping hand, with his other hand separately on the table. The unexposed palm surface is not asserted here and is failed under support/visibility.

embodiment_joint_chain_and_reach.evidence: The inspector shoulder-side forearm, wrist, gripping hand and stamp handle form a coherent reachable chain to the flat tag. The central elbows/forearms reach the submitted towel without an observed contradictory bend. The hidden support surface is assessed separately rather than diagnosed as a deformity.

embodiment_support_and_balance.evidence: The image-left supporting hand meets the towel, and image-right fingertips appear under its lower edge. The image-right upward palm and wrist-to-palm support boundary are concealed by the towel, so the intended complete two-palm load-bearing state cannot be verified. Plausible support is not full visible support evidence.

embodiment_contact_and_space.evidence: The inspector gripping hand controls the upright stamp; its flat base/contact edge meets the horizontal cream paper face. The paper lies on the towel and the dark clip crosses its near corner at the towel edge. These upper contact boundaries are readable together and the other inspector hand stays separate.

embodiment_visibility_and_projection.evidence: The face, stamp-to-tag contact and tag/towel corner are inspectable, but the image-right supporting palm and its direct support boundary are occluded under the towel; only fingertips emerge. The whole required stamp→tag→towel→two-palms route therefore remains partial at original 1312x1199 scale.

pixel_review.finding: The upper stamp→horizontal tag→clipped towel relation is visible, but the image-right supporting palm is hidden beneath the towel and only fingertips emerge. Full two-palm support remains partial. Reference face/hair features are visible.
pixel_review.future_local_repair_target: Expose the same central participant image-right palm and its towel support boundary through towel width/hand placement while preserving the inspector stamp, tag attachment and all other passed relations. No further image was generated.
